title: Finite selection of module stalk detectors over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let Λ be a Noetherian commutative ring, X a Noetherian scheme, and F a constructible Λ-module sheaf. Given a family of module-sheaf maps out of F such that every geometric stalk has an injective member, there is a finite subfamily whose biproduct lift is a monomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the Noetherian-object argument of Stacks Tag 09Z6 (3). For a finite family of the maps, take its joint kernel. If this kernel is nonzero, choose a geometric stalk where it is nonzero and add a map that is injective on that stalk; the joint kernel strictly decreases. The ascending-chain argument for constructible subsheaves of a constructible sheaf over a Noetherian ring shows that this process terminates after finitely many additions. At termination every geometric stalk of the joint kernel is zero, so conservativity of geometric stalks makes the finite joint map monomorphic. Reindex the selected family by Fin n.
